negative_control: apply the analytic in-plasma condition at the named stage and show the exterior current removed

target_receipt.construction: closed-form polynomial current density integrated over the exact traced separatrix supports, including first cell moments

conclusion: The whole-cell profile carrier is not itself the current-booking error. The first current moment is written when _flux_selected_current_moments clips that carrier with the cell-local quadratic psi_N=1 level, samples the profile density on the same local polynomial, and integrates the fitted density over that support. The production-local level admits analytic-exterior cells and under-covers analytic separatrix-cut cells.
